messages:
dani: Heads up — deploy-bot just marked release 2026.03.18-rc2 as BLOCKED for canary because the traffic split conflicts with the change window. Is anyone oncall for handoff?

deploy-bot: [auto] Release 2026.03.18-rc2 status -> BLOCKED. Reason: change_window mismatch (policy: 22:00-02:00 UTC) and requested split includes global audience. See /deploy logs.

sasha: I scheduled the rollout to start at 21:30 UTC to catch APAC, that’s probably why. We should either shift the window or limit canary to non-global region.

raj: Can we do a temporary gating exception? This is a tiny traffic split (2%) for the new reranker; we have fallback.

dani: We have an approval flow that prevents exceptions during the high-risk change window. @elaine are you ok granting an exception given the telemetry from last night?

elaine: need quick perf/latency numbers first. Where are the preflight metrics?

matt: Telemetry: last 3 runs avg p95 generation latency +5ms, error rate 0.01%. Rolling failure rate looks stable. I can paste the dashboard link: https://console.redwood/rollouts/2026.03.18-rc2/telemetry

raj: That seems fine. If we still want to preserve the window, how about scoping the canary to region=eu-west-1 only? That avoids the global rule and keeps APAC for later.

sasha: Agreed. But the change window policy is topology-aware: it blocks any split that includes global or >3 regions. Setting single-region should pass.

dani: OK, two options: (1) shift window to 20:30-00:30 UTC (requires product sign-off), (2) scope canary to eu-west-1 and re-run deploy. Which is faster?

elaine: Option 2. Less stakeholder noise. Can someone run the quick config edit and re-trigger? Also add an audit note.

matt: I'll push the override to the canary config. Small YAML diff:```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 2%
  scope: region: eu-west-1
  guard: rollback_on_error: true
```

matt: Pushing change now...

deploy-bot: [auto] Received config update for release 2026.03.18-rc2. Validating against rollout policies...

deploy-bot: [auto] Validation PASSED: region-scoped canary within change window constraints. Queuing for approval re-check.

rollout-bot: Please add an audit entry explaining the exception rationale. Use `/rollout audit add 1840123456 "scoped canary to eu-west-1 to avoid change-window conflict; telemetry ok"`

raj: /rollout audit add 1840123456 "scoped canary to eu-west-1 to avoid change-window conflict; telemetry ok" :white_check_mark:

dani: @elaine any last objections?

elaine: none from me. Approving.

deploy-bot: [auto] Approval recorded by elaine. Release 2026.03.18-rc2 -> SCHEDULED. Canary split: 2% eu-west-1.

sasha: Nice — keep an eye on the prefix cache metrics for the first 5 minutes. If anything weird, I'll flip traffic back to 0.

matt: noted. I’ll watch the console and set a 10m alert window.

raj: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: can we add a minor UX tweak to the console so the change-window policy shows which fields trigger a block (global vs >3 regions)? This would save a few back-and-forths.

dani: yes +1. Filing a tiny product ticket.

matt: ticket created: https://issues.redwood/PRD-4721 — label: rollout-ux, priority: low

rollout-bot: [auto] Reminder: post-canary evaluation scheduled at +15m after canary start.

sasha: all clear, closing thread unless deploys fail. :thumbsup:
